idea: My first day in Tel Aviv as an Indian vegetarian: what I ate

hooks.en: Can a pure veg Indian survive Tel Aviv?
hooks.hi: क्या एक प्योर वेज इंडियन तेल अवीव में टिक पाएगा?
hooks.hinglish: Kya ek pure veg Indian Tel Aviv mein survive karega?
hooks.shot: You standing on a Tel Aviv street, holding up an empty plate with a worried face.
hooks.why: Every Indian vegetarian who travels has asked this exact question about a new city.

hooks.en: POV: You're vegetarian and just landed in Tel Aviv
hooks.hi: POV: आप वेजिटेरियन हैं और अभी तेल अवीव पहुँचे हैं
hooks.hinglish: POV: Aap vegetarian ho aur abhi Tel Aviv land kiya
hooks.shot: Selfie shot walking out of the airport with your bag, looking around for food.
hooks.why: The viewer steps into your shoes and wants to see how the first day goes.

hooks.en: I didn't expect to eat this well in Tel Aviv
hooks.hi: तेल अवीव में इतना अच्छा खाना मिलेगा, सोचा नहीं था
hooks.hinglish: Tel Aviv mein itna accha khana milega, socha nahi tha
hooks.shot: Close-up of your first bite, cut before we see the full dish.
hooks.why: It promises a good surprise and holds back what the food is.

hooks.en: First day in Tel Aviv, and I was starving
hooks.hi: तेल अवीव में पहला दिन, और मुझे ज़ोर की भूख लगी थी
hooks.hinglish: Tel Aviv mein pehla din, aur bhookh se haal kharab
hooks.onScreen_hi: पहला दिन: भूखा तेल अवीव में
hooks.shot: You rubbing your stomach outside a busy food stall.
hooks.why: Hunger in a new country is an instant problem the viewer wants solved.

hooks.en: Everyone said I'd go hungry in Tel Aviv
hooks.hi: सबने कहा था तेल अवीव में भूखा रहूँगा
hooks.hinglish: Sabne bola tha Tel Aviv mein bhookha rahega
hooks.onScreen: Veg in Tel Aviv? They doubted
hooks.onScreen_hi: तेल अवीव में वेज? सबको शक था
hooks.shot: You raising an eyebrow at the camera, a full plate just out of frame.
hooks.why: It pushes back on a fear every Indian vegetarian family has before a trip.

hooks.en: Don't pack Maggi for Tel Aviv. Here's why
hooks.hi: तेल अवीव के लिए मैगी मत पैक करना, देखो क्यों
hooks.hinglish: Tel Aviv ke liye Maggi pack mat karna, dekho kyun
hooks.shot: You taking Maggi packets out of a suitcase and putting them aside.
hooks.why: Packing instant food abroad is a very Indian habit, so viewers see themselves in it.
